description: Show which canonical fields carry one O-DEF semantic code (free). This is the reverse lookup a connector needs: given a field in a source system, find where in the Open Footprint model it belongs. Codes carried by more than ten fields are returned with an explicit caution — they are generic classifications, and aligning to one asserts far less than it appears to.
name: ofp_semantic_code
title: ofp_semantic_code
